info.text:
The average qualifying Dogtopia location took in $935,548 in 2025 (franchise disclosure document, Item 19).

Revenue: daycare days, overnight boarding, and add-ons like baths and training. Payroll is one of its biggest costs.
The brand takes a 7% royalty and a 2% marketing fee: about $65,488 and $18,711 on that average.
APPA: Americans spent $14.3B on grooming, boarding, training and other services in 2025, though boarding use fell.

Sources: Dogtopia FDD (2026); APPA State of the Industry (2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
